title: ChemPro
description: A mod that adds stuff from the periodic table and more!
body:
# ChemPro
This mod adds a tone of content from the elements of the periodic and chemistry. This was a school project and I originaly had 3 days to make this but I plan on updating the mod every so often.

## Elements
There are many elements in the mod with multiple having a purposes that can craft helpful items. There are so far **31 Elements so far**.
## Custom Recipes
Multiple elements give new ways to make vanilla items and more.
<details>
<summary>Recipes</summary>

- Bucket + 2 Oxygen + Hydrogen = **Water Bucket**
- Copper Ingot + 2 Iron Ingot = **Empty Battery**
- Empty Battery + 8 Lithium = **Lithium Battery**
- 4 Neon + Ink Sac = **Glow Ink Sac**
</details>
